# World Protocol and WorldDevKit

Canonical docs: https://docs.kobotai.co/world
Source: https://github.com/KobotAI/world-protocol
Protocol level: Level 1
Protocol version: world/0.1
Library package version: 0.1.1
Initializer version: create-worlddevkit@0.1.2
Runtime: Node.js 20+

WorldDevKit packages:
- create-worlddevkit
- @worlddevkit/spec
- @worlddevkit/server
- @worlddevkit/client
- @worlddevkit/testing
- @worlddevkit/core
- @worlddevkit/geo

Local quickstart:
1. npm create worlddevkit@latest my-world
2. cd my-world
3. npm install
4. npm run dev
5. npm run typecheck
6. npm test

Agent guide: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/agents/build-a-world
Quickstart: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/getting-started/quickstart
Discovery: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/getting-started/discovery
Deployment: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/guides/deploy-a-world
Level 1 API: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/reference/level-1-api
OpenAPI: https://docs.kobotai.co/world/docs/reference/openapi.yaml

Rules:
- Discovery is GET /.well-known/world.json.
- Discover the API endpoint; do not hardcode it in clients.
- Start from the project generated by create-worlddevkit.
- Local default is http://localhost:8787.
- Production identity is supplied with WORLD_URL.
- No credentials, database, or Docker are required for the starter.
